hand.notes: Confirmed: the fix says "Bun treats --production as frozen, so the old fallback could never recover a stale lockfile" and refreshes it with --lockfile-only first. Line 1720 is the reviewed install_runtime_deps fallback.
hand.summary: setup's fallback after a failed frozen production install ran bun install --production, which Bun also treats as frozen, so a fork or local edit with a stale bun.lock could never install.
